close_reason: OutboundMailer trait + SmtpRelayMailer implemented. email/set.rs uses Arc<dyn OutboundMailer>. All 276 tests pass, clippy clean.
description:
## Why this issue exists

Phase 1 of epic stoa-y0p2j. Define the OutboundMailer trait in stoa-smtp and migrate the existing SmtpRelayQueue delivery path into a SmtpRelayMailer that implements it. Update the call site in email/set.rs to take Arc<dyn OutboundMailer> instead of Option<&Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>>.

## What needs to be done

1. Add OutboundEnvelope, SendReceipt, OutboundError, and OutboundMailer trait to stoa-smtp (new module outbound_mailer.rs)
2. Implement SmtpRelayMailer wrapping Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>
3. Update handle_email_create signature: smtp_queue param becomes outbound_mailer: Option<&Arc<dyn OutboundMailer>>
4. Update JmapStores to hold Option<Arc<dyn OutboundMailer>> instead of Option<Arc<SmtpRelayQueue>>
5. Update call site in server.rs and main.rs wiring
6. All existing tests must pass unchanged (behavior-neutral refactor)

## Acceptance criteria

- email/set.rs has no reference to SmtpRelayQueue
- SmtpRelayMailer implements OutboundMailer, wraps SmtpRelayQueue
- All existing relay queue tests pass
- cargo clippy --workspace -- -D warnings clean
title: Phase 1: OutboundMailer trait + SmtpRelayMailer impl
